title: When does off-block Hessian curvature help an optimization step?
description: Testing an off-block Hessian correction alone can discard a combined step that lowers minibatch loss. The code and records compare the standalone, remainder-only and combined corrections at a fixed base step, then test whether shortening the remainder changes the choice. A reference based on diagonal-block norms separates changes in the curvature profile from changes in relative off-block mass.
